correct_python_compilation: Passed; Numba compiles the ordinary causal loop during first normal production. No synthetic trials, unit tests, checker or test-only CLI.
source_consumption: Each own monthly NPY is hashed against its sealed acquisition record before price decoding. Generate completed M1 bars only on later ticks and retain exact closing/discovery source ordinals.
feature_semantics: A gap clears the next window and arming after the preceding valid-prefix event has been retained. A below-minimum sigma emits no event; an inside close may arm. Rolling mean/population variance use a direct two-pass calculation over 60 strictly prior closes.
supply_semantics: The frozen structural screen is an optimistic upper bound ignoring expiry and monetary rejections. Its pre-cutoff events must have nominal and discovery times in the declared entry period; all delayed emissions remain in the event tape and the fresh subset is reported separately. Dates/years attach to actual discovery, never an invented earlier executable timestamp.
no_outcome_work: No forward return, fill, target/stop path, risk amount, accepted trade or profit exists at freeze. All three policies retain their unchanged monetary contract and genuine fill turnover gates.
